direction: Normalized mean of the seven admitted geocentric receiver directions; fixed synthetic design, not a target state or prior.
station_geometry: Fixed receiver coordinates from positions.json index 70 (10:35:00); static receiver geometry in synthetic vacuum model.
calibration: Equal-weight reference mean per receiver/epoch. Shared-satellite coefficients use the same six-other-station chronological training and minimum-norm gauge as spatial_reference. Linear additive error transport; not the full nonlinear RF calibration.
scope: Real receiver coordinates and reference incidence; entirely synthetic target trajectory, vacuum code-only geometry and invented error amplitudes/correlations. No target data or orbit, production changes, real covariance identification or 95-percent coverage claim.
stopping_rule: All six synthetic radius/speed designs and both correction operators; retain below-mask/rank failures. No selection by output quality. Report additive unit-mode sensitivity and unchanged 20m independent-code control, never replace existing real uncertainty floors with measured residual RMS.
supersedes: v1 retained as centered-window sensitivity: its +60 seconds is inside the sample window. v2 anchors t=0 at the final endpoint, so +60 seconds is genuinely outside the synthetic observation window. Same scenarios and no outcome-based selection.
